description:
Clean up a legacy installation guide (/home/ga/Documents/legacy_install_guide.docx) by replacing manual direct formatting with proper LibreOffice Writer Styles. 

1. Find all main titles (text in 'Arial Black', ~18pt) and apply the 'Heading 1' paragraph style.
2. Find all subtitles (text in 'Arial', 14pt, Bold) and apply the 'Heading 2' paragraph style.
3. Find all code snippets (text in 'Courier New') and apply the 'Source Text' character style.
4. Find all warning text (text in Red color) and apply the 'Strong Emphasis' character style.

Save the cleaned document as /home/ga/Documents/styled_install_guide.docx. Do NOT overwrite the original file.
